_help: THE HACK (navigation/hack.py): her lines while she maps a settlement for the East Orion Company. Fields: {settlement} {found} {percent} {need} {layout} {next_name} {next_system} {next_distance} {next_group}. Keep them short and clear: some testers are in their 70s.
Hack_Offer: The East Orion Company has no map of {settlement}. I can make one, but I need to be near the terminals, gun posts and supply points. Say start hack when you're ready.
Nobody has mapped this base for the EOC yet. Say start hack, then walk me round the terminals and the gun posts. I'll do the rest.
This one is not on the EOC's books. Say start hack and stay close to the terminals and gun posts. Keep walking, and I'll get the data.
Hack_Known: The EOC already has this base on file. A second look never hurts, though. Say start hack if you want to double check it.
We've mapped this one before. Say start hack if you'd like me to check it again.
Hack_Start: Opening a line to the East Orion Company. Please hold. It's old technology, but it works.
Linking up with the EOC. Dialling in now. Stay close to the terminals and the gun posts, and keep walking.
Connecting to the East Orion Company. Walk the whole base for me. Terminals, gun posts and supply points are what I need.
Hack_Progress_25: Handshake complete. The base's security is asleep, as usual. Keep moving.
A quarter of the way in. Nobody has noticed us yet. That's the best kind of hack.
Hack_Progress_50: Halfway there. I can feel the layout now. The rooms are starting to fit together.
Fifty percent. The doors are starting to line up. I've always been good with doors.
Hack_Progress_75: Nearly through. The last part is always the quiet corners.
Seventy five percent. Just the awkward bits left. Keep walking.
Hack_Complete: Hack complete. {settlement} is mapped. The East Orion Company will be delighted, and they will never say so.
That's it. {settlement} is in the EOC's files. Good work, Commander.
Base mapped. I have what I need from {settlement}. Sending it to the EOC. Well, to the zip file.
Hack_Layout: My best guess is that this base is {layout}.
I think this is {layout}. The EOC can check me.
Hack_NoLayout: I can't tell which layout this is yet. I'll leave that one for the EOC to work out.
I couldn't work out the layout. I've kept everything I saw.
Hack_Timeout: The link timed out. I've kept what I saw, but a second walk round would help.
Out of time. I've saved everything, though I'd like another go at the quiet corners.
Hack_Aborted: Hack cancelled. Whatever I already have is saved.
Line closed. I've kept what I found.
Hack_Lost: I've lost the link, because you've left the base. I've kept what I had.
Signal lost. You've wandered off. What I saw is saved.
Hack_NoSettlement: There's no base to hack here. Walk up to a settlement on foot first.
I can't find a base near you. Get out of the ship and walk up to one first.
Hack_NotOnFoot: I can only read the radar when you're on foot. Step out of the ship and try again.
Get out of the ship first, Commander. The radar only shows when you're on foot.
Hack_NoRadar: I can't see the radar. Is the game in windowed or borderless mode, and is the radar showing?
No radar, no hack. Check the game is in borderless or windowed mode, then try again.
Hack_AlreadyRunning: The hack is already running. Keep walking.
Hack_NotRunning: There's no hack running at the moment.
Nothing to stop. Say start hack when you're on foot at a base.
Hack_Disabled: The hack game is switched off in the settings.
That's switched off in the settings, I'm afraid.
Hack_Next: Next target: {next_name}, in the {next_system} system, about {next_distance} light years away. A {next_group} base, if the files are right.
The EOC would like {next_name} next. It's in {next_system}, about {next_distance} light years from here.
Hack_NextNone: I can't find the next target just now. Try again later, or pick any base you like.
No next target from here. Fly to any settlement you haven't done and say start hack.
Hack_Reward: That went well. I'm in a better mood now.
A good day's work. I feel better for it.
